name: Official air quality stations
summary: Hourly PM2.5 and PM10 from the national air-quality stations of Cyprus, as reported to the European Environment Agency. Up-to-date values: not yet checked by the authorities.

el.name: Επίσημοι σταθμοί ποιότητας αέρα
el.summary: Ωριαία PM2.5 και PM10 από τους εθνικούς σταθμούς ποιότητας αέρα της Κύπρου, όπως αναφέρονται στον Ευρωπαϊκό Οργανισμό Περιβάλλοντος. Πρόσφατες τιμές: δεν έχουν ελεγχθεί ακόμη.

publisher.name: European Environment Agency (EEA), from data reported by the Cyprus Department of Labour Inspection

licence.attribution: European Environment Agency (EEA), Air Quality Download Service; data reported by the Cyprus Department of Labour Inspection

update.note: The server asks the EEA once an hour and keeps about 5 weeks of hourly values. The EEA's own delay (hours) is not known yet.

quality.uncertainty: Reference-grade instruments, but the newest values are unchecked, and a station can be several km from a school (a traffic station reads differently from a quiet street).
known_issues: Up-to-date (E2a) values are unvalidated and can change later
Only a few stations on the island; the nearest one can be far from a school
Not yet confirmed from the real EEA service: the file format, the time zone of the hours and how late the values arrive

upstream.name: Cyprus Department of Labour Inspection air-quality network

restrictions: Credit the European Environment Agency wherever these values are shown, and say that they are unvalidated up-to-date data
Never call a school sensor 'certified' or 'wrong' because of a comparison with a station that is kilometres away

use_for: How much PM2.5 and PM10 the nearest official station reports, hour by hour
Checking whether a school's low-cost particle sensor goes up and down together with the official station
not_for: Ozone, nitrogen dioxide or other gases (only particles are read)
A health warning: official alerts come from the authorities

notes: Read by eea.js, served at /api/eea. POST /ParquetFile/urls gives one Parquet file per sampling point (hourly, dataset 1); station places and types come from the EEA metadata CSV, with the station map service as fallback. Not tried against the real service from the build sandbox: after a deploy look in the Railway log for 'EEA air quality: first update done'. Licence stays unknown until the dataset factsheet is read; the EEA says in general its data may be reused with credit.
